40844-the-diva-s-ruby.title: "Primadonna" And "Fair Margaret"
40844-the-diva-s-ruby.creator: F. Marion Crawford
40844-the-diva-s-ruby.description: A book by F. Marion Crawford. There is a ruby mine hidden in the heart of the mountains near a remote little city of Central Asia, unknown to European travellers; and the secret of the treasure belongs to the two chief families of the place, and has been carefully guarded for many generations, handed down through the men from father to son; and often the children of these two families have married, yet none of the women ever learned the way to the mine from their fathers, or their brothers,

56553-the-sugar-creek-gang-digs-for-trea.title: _The Sugar Creek Gang Digs For Treasure_
56553-the-sugar-creek-gang-digs-for-trea.creator: Paul Hutchens
56553-the-sugar-creek-gang-digs-for-trea.description: A book by Paul Hutchens. It seemed to be getting hotter every minute though--the kind of day we sometimes had back home at Sugar Creek just before some big thunderheads came sneaking up and surprised us with a fierce storm. It was also a perfect day for a sunbath. What on earth made people want to get brown all over for anyway?

arxiv-2012-09646.title: DAG-based Scheduling with Resource Sharing for Multi-task Applications in a Polyglot GPU Runtime
arxiv-2012-09646.creator: Alberto Parravicini, Arnaud Delamare, Marco Arnaboldi, Marco D. Santambrogio
arxiv-2012-09646.description: Abstract GPUs are readily available in cloud computing and personal devices, but their use for data processing acceleration has been slowed down by their limited integration with common programming languages such as Python or Java. Moreover, using GPUs to their full capabilities requires expert knowledge of asynchronous programming.

arxiv-2104-12992.title: Bayesian cosmological inference through implicit cross-correlation statistics
arxiv-2104-12992.creator: G. Lavaux, J. Jasche
arxiv-2104-12992.description: Abstract Analyzes of next-generation galaxy data require accurate treatment of systematic effects such as the bias between observed galaxies and the underlying matter density field. However, proposed models of the phenomenon are either numerically expensive or too inaccurate to achieve unbiased inferences of cosmological parameters even at mildly-nonlinear scales of the data.

arxiv-2108-08335.title: Exploring an experimental route of synthesizing superheavy elements beyond Z > > 118 Preprint: Synth of SHE/Feb 2021
arxiv-2108-08335.creator: H.C. Manjunatha 1 , Y.S.Vidya 2 , P.S.Damodara Gupta 1 , N.Manjunatha 1 , N.Sowmya 1 , L.Seenappa 1 and T. Nandi 3‡
arxiv-2108-08335.description: Abstract Role of the Coulomb interaction, mean fissility, mass asymmetry, and charge asymmetry parameters on the synthesis of heavy and superheavy elements has been examined with respect to the deformation parameters of the projectile and target nuclei explicitly in light of the experimental results.

arxiv-2109-11695.title: Generalized transitionless quantum driving for open quantum systems
arxiv-2109-11695.creator: Alan C. Santos, Marcelo S. Sarandy
arxiv-2109-11695.description: Abstract A general approach for transitionless quantum driving in open quantum systems is introduced. Under the assumption of adiabatic evolution for time-local master equations, we derive the generalized transitionless Lindbladian required to implement a shortcut to adiabaticity in an open system scenario.

arxiv-2204-08112.title: Testing synchrotron models and frequency resolution in BINGO 21 cm simulated maps using GNILC
arxiv-2204-08112.creator: Eduardo J. de Mericia ,, Larissa C. O. Santos, Carlos Alexandre Wuensche, Vincenzo Liccardo, Camila P. Novaes, Jacques Delabrouille, Mathieu Remazeilles, Filipe Abdalla, Chang Feng, Luciano Barosi, Amilcar Queiroz, Thyrso Villela, Bin Wang, Jiajun Zhang, Andre A. Costa, Elisa G.M. Ferreira, Ricardo
arxiv-2204-08112.description: Abstract Context. The 21 cm hydrogen line is arguably one of the most powerful probes to explore the Universe, from recombination to the present times. To recover it, it is essential to separate the cosmological signal from the much stronger foreground contributions at radio frequencies.

arxiv-2302-06302.title: Flybys in debris disk systems with Gaia eDR3
arxiv-2302-06302.creator: L. Bertini, V. Roccatagliata ,, M. Kim
arxiv-2302-06302.description: Abstract Context. Debris disks represent the last phase of the evolution of protoplanetary disks around young stellar objects where planetary systems had most likely already been formed. Resolved systems show peculiar structures, such as asymmetries or spirals, which may be associated with either the presence of a low-mass companion or dynamical interactions with a perturber during a flyby event. Aims.

arxiv-2310-14168.title: Randomized forward mode of automatic differentiation for optimization algorithms Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2310-14168.creator: Khemraj Shukla, Yeonjong Shin
arxiv-2310-14168.description: Abstract We present a randomized forward mode gradient (RFG) as an alternative to backpropagation. RFG is a random estimator for the gradient that is constructed based on the directional derivative along a random vector. The forward mode automatic differentiation (AD) provides an efficient computation of RFG. The probability distribution of the random vector determines the statistical properties of RFG.

arxiv-2408-06260.title: Exploring the links between quasar winds and radio emission along the Main Sequence at high redshift Thanks: Based on observations collected at ESO under programs 086.B-0774(A), 085.B-0162(A), and 083.B-0273(A).
arxiv-2408-06260.creator: A. Deconto-Machado, A. del Olmo, P. Marziani
arxiv-2408-06260.description: Abstract Context. Despite the increasing prevalence of radio-loud (RL) sources at cosmic noon, our understanding of the underlying physics that governs the accretion disc outflows in these particular sources and its dissimilarity with radio-quiet (RQ) quasars remains somewhat limited. Aims. Disentangling the real impact of the radio-loudness and accretion on the outflow parameters remains a challenge to this day.

arxiv-2409-13850.title: Predicting the Number of Radio Sources Seen by Both VLASS and LSST
arxiv-2409-13850.creator: Alex Tellez, Yjan Gordon, Keith Bechtol
arxiv-2409-13850.description: Abstract Radio surveys typically sample extragalactic sources in higher redshift regimes than is typical for optical surveys, resulting in many radio sources not having a detected optical counterpart. Over the next decade the Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) will be performing the deepest ( i < 26.4 i<26.

arxiv-2410-06186.title: The Last Iterate Advantage: Empirical Auditing and Principled Heuristic Analysis of Differentially Private SGD
arxiv-2410-06186.creator: Thomas Steinke, Milad Nasr, Arun Ganesh, Borja Balle, Christopher A. Choquette-ChooMatthew Jagielski, Jamie Hayes, Abhradeep Guha Thakurta, Adam Smith, Andreas Terzis
arxiv-2410-06186.description: Abstract We propose a simple heuristic privacy analysis of noisy clipped stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) in the setting where only the last iterate is released and the intermediate iterates remain hidden. Namely, our heuristic assumes a linear structure for the model. We show experimentally that our heuristic is predictive of the outcome of privacy auditing applied to various training procedures.

arxiv-2505-22972.title: On the discrete Hilbert-type operators Thanks: The author was supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant Nos. 11501157).
arxiv-2505-22972.creator: Jianjun Jin
arxiv-2505-22972.description: Abstract . Recently, Bansah and Sehba studied in [ 3 ] the boundedness of a family of Hilbert-type integral operators, in which they characterized the L p − L q L^{p}-L^{q} boundedness of the operators for 1 ≤ p ≤ q ≤ ∞ 1\leq p\leq q\leq\infty .

arxiv-2506-17661.title: New Determination of the 14 C(n, γ \gamma ) 15 C Reaction Rate and Its Astrophysical Implications
arxiv-2506-17661.creator: Yuchen Jiang, Zhenyu He, Yudong Luo, Wenyu Xin, Jie Chen, Xinyue Li, Yangping Shen, Bing Guo, Guo Li, Danyang Pang, Tianli Ma, Weike Nan, Toshitaka Kajino, Weiping Liu
arxiv-2506-17661.description: Abstract We present a novel experiment to investigate the spectroscopic factor of the 15 C ground state for the first time using single-neutron r ​ e ​ m ​ o ​ v ​ a ​ l removal transfer reactions on 15 C.

arxiv-2510-19507.title: Teaming LLMs to Detect and Mitigate Hallucinations
arxiv-2510-19507.creator: Demian Till 1 John Smeaton 1 Peter Haubrick 1 Gouse Saheb 1 Florian Graef 1 David Berman 2
arxiv-2510-19507.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Demian Till 1 John Smeaton 1 Peter Haubrick 1 Gouse Saheb 1 Florian Graef 1 David Berman 2. Recent work has demonstrated state-of-the-art results in large language model (LLM) hallucination detection and mitigation through consistency-based approaches which involve aggregating multiple responses sampled from a single LLM for a given prompt. These approaches help offset limitations stemming from the imperfect data on which LLMs are trained, which includes biases and under-representation of information required at deployment time among other limitations which can lead to hallucinations.

arxiv-2602-23148.title: On Sample-Efficient Generalized Planning via Learned Transition Models
arxiv-2602-23148.creator: Nitin Gupta, Vishal Pallagani, John A. Aydin, Biplav Srivastava
arxiv-2602-23148.description: Abstract Generalized planning studies the construction of solution strategies that generalize across families of planning problems sharing a common domain model, formally defined by a transition function γ : S × A → S \gamma:S\times A\rightarrow S . Classical approaches achieve such generalization through symbolic abstractions and explicit reasoning over γ \gamma .

arxiv-2605-08557.title: MC-RFM: Geometry-Aware Few-Shot Adaptation via Mixed-Curvature Riemannian Flow Matching
arxiv-2605-08557.creator: Salim Khazem, Ibrahim Mohamed Serouis, Zakaria Ezzahed

arxiv-2605-22504.title: LACO: Adaptive Latent Communication for Collaborative Driving
arxiv-2605-22504.creator: Tianhao Chen, Yuheng Wu, Dongman Lee

pmc-10588908.title: Topological Darkness in Optical Heterostructures: Prediction and Confirmation
pmc-10588908.creator: Emma Cusworth, Vasyl G Kravets, Alexander N Grigorenko
pmc-10588908.description: Topological darkness is a new phenomenon that guarantees zero reflection/transmission of light from an optical sample and hence provides topologically nontrivial phase singularities. Here we consider topological darkness in an optical heterostructure that consists of an (unknown) layer placed on a composite substrate and suggest an algorithm that can be used to predict and confirm the presence of topological darkness.

pmc-10626538.title: Novel strategies in antithrombotic therapy: targeting thrombosis while preserving hemostasis
pmc-10626538.creator: Martha M. S. Sim, Semekidus Shiferawe, Jeremy P. Wood
pmc-10626538.description: Antithrombotic therapy is a delicate balance between the benefits of preventing a thrombotic event and the risks of inducing a major bleed. Traditional approaches have included antiplatelet and anticoagulant medications, require careful dosing and monitoring, and all carry some risk of bleeding.

pmc-10654175.title: Recent Updates on Predicting Conversion in Youth at Clinical High Risk for Psychosis
pmc-10654175.creator: Noe Caballero, Siddharth Machiraju, Anthony Diomino, Leda Kennedy, Armita Kadivar, Kristin S. Cadenhead
pmc-10654175.description: Purpose of ReviewThis review highlights recent advances in the prediction and treatment of psychotic conversion. Over the past 25 years, research into the prodromal phase of psychotic illness has expanded with the promise of early identification of individuals at clinical high risk (CHR) for psychosis who are likely to convert to psychosis.

pmc-10669805.title: Prolonged Secondary Stroke Prevention with Edoxaban: A Long-Term Follow-Up of the SATES Study
pmc-10669805.creator: Irene Scala, Simone Bellavia, Pier Andrea Rizzo, Jacopo Di Giovanni, Mauro Monforte, Roberta Morosetti, Giacomo Della Marca, Fabio Pilato, Aldobrando Broccolini, Paolo Profice, Giovanni Frisullo, Simona Lattanzi
pmc-10669805.description: Background: Little evidence is available on the long-term efficacy and safety of edoxaban, mainly due to the recent release date. The primary objective of the study was to evaluate the safety of edoxaban, defined by the incidence of major bleedings. We then aimed to evaluate the incidence of thromboembolic events and the persistence of edoxaban therapy in the long-term.

pmc-10737342.title: ADAPTING TO THE HEALTH RESEARCH MENTORING LANDSCAPE: THE ENHANCING RESEARCH FOR ONLINE LEARNERS (ENROLL) PROGRAM
pmc-10737342.creator: Matthew Peterson
pmc-10737342.description: Engaging students in mentored research has contemporary challenges, including virtual environments and student disengagement. This provides an opportunity to develop novel methods to attract and support students in health research, with the goal of encouraging a career in the health sciences.

pmc-11412967.title: Two-plus-two fringe projection profilometry based on phase-shifted coding
pmc-11412967.creator: Hechen Zhang, Jin Zhou, Dan Jia, Jinlong Huang, Jin Yuan
pmc-11412967.description: In fringe projection profilometry based on temporal phase unwrapping, determining a fringe order map commonly requires a large number of fringes. To reduce the fringe number, this paper proposes a concise absolute phase retrieval algorithm just by projecting four fringes. The first two orthogonal fringes with relatively large frequency can collect reliable height information.

pmc-11609060.title: Bevacizumab for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer complicated by abdominal aortic aneurysm and mural thrombus: a case report
pmc-11609060.creator: Yujun Li, Tong Wu, Muhammad Muddasar Saeed, Xiaonan Cui
pmc-11609060.description: Bevacizumab, a humanized monoclonal antibody targeting vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), was the first anti-angiogenic agent incorporated into metastatic colorectal cancer treatment strategies and demonstrated broad-spectrum anti-tumor efficacy. Commonly reported adverse events include hypertension, proteinuria, gastrointestinal perforation, bleeding, and thromboembolism. However, there are only a few reports on abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA) as a complication of bevacizumab therapy.

pmc-11612381.title: Development of a finer-resolution multi-year emission inventory for open biomass burning in Heilongjiang Province, China
pmc-11612381.creator: Bin Li, Zehua Xu, Baiyin Liu, Zhimiao Zhang, Wenting Qiu, Wei Wang
pmc-11612381.description: Open biomass burning (OBB) is a significant source of air pollutants, profoundly impacting regional air quality and global climate change. However, due to the lack of high-resolution burned area products, limited biomass data resolution, and inappropriate emission factors (EFs), current OBB emission inventories have significant uncertainties.

pmc-11615515.title: Risk and protective factors for ASF in domestic pigs and wild boar in the EU, and mitigation measures for managing the disease in wild boar
pmc-11615515.creator: European Food Safety Authority (EFSA), Anette Ella Boklund, Karl Ståhl, Miguel Ángel Miranda Chueca, Tomasz Podgórski, Timothée Vergne, José Cortiñas Abrahantes, Eleonora Cattaneo, Sofie Dhollander, Alexandra Papanikolaou, Stefania Tampach, Lina Mur
pmc-11615515.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Five epidemiological aspects of ASF were evaluated using literature reviews, field studies, questionnaires and mathematical models. First, a literature review and a case–control study in commercial pig farms emphasised the importance of biosecurity and farming practices, including the spread of manure around farms and the use of bedding material as risk factors, while the use of insect nets was a protective factor.

pmc-11789724.title: Response to “A bibliometric and knowledge-map study on the treatment of hematological malignancies with CAR-T cells from 2012 to 2023: A correspondence”
pmc-11789724.creator: Huimin Li, Qing Huang, Yuan Zhang
pmc-11789724.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We are also willing to have an academic discussion with them on their questions. posited that our manuscript lacked the h-index of researchers and the cooperative analysis of research institutions. While the incorporation of the h-index may enhance the research findings, it is important to note that the h-index is not an indispensable metric for the bibliometric analysis. The h-index serves as a measure of researchers’ academic productivity and impact, taking into consideration both the quantity and citation frequency of their publications.

pmc-12356525.title: Balance Improvement and Fall Risk Reduction in Stroke Survivors After Treatment With a Wearable Home-Use Gait Device: Single-Arm Longitudinal Study With 1-Year Follow-Up
pmc-12356525.creator: Brianne Darcy, Lauren Rashford, David Huizenga, Kyle B Reed, Stacy J M Bamberg, Amaryllis Mavragani
pmc-12356525.description: BackgroundFalls are a common and serious problem after stroke, often leading to injuries, loss of independence, and increased health care usage. Functional balance, a primary risk factor for falls, is frequently impaired in individuals with hemiparetic gait impairments. Previous research with the iStride gait device (Moterum Technologies, Inc) showed that functional balance improved immediately following 4 weeks of treatment.

pmc-12488897.title: Spatial attention selectively alters visual cortical representation during target anticipation
pmc-12488897.creator: Ekin Tünçok, Marisa Carrasco, Jonathan Winawer
pmc-12488897.description: Attention enables us to efficiently and flexibly interact with the environment by prioritizing specific image locations and features in preparation for responding to stimuli. Using a concurrent psychophysics–fMRI experiment, we investigate how covert spatial attention modulates responses in human visual cortex before target onset and how it affects subsequent behavioral performance.

pmc-12511359.title: Langmuir-Schaefer deposition of 2D PbS quantum dot superlattices with millimetre square coverage
pmc-12511359.creator: Jacopo Pinna, Alexandru Mednicov, Razieh Mehrabi Koushki, Majid Ahmadi, José Ruiz-Franco, Andrea Giuntoli, Bart J. Kooi, Giuseppe Portale, Maria Antonietta Loi
pmc-12511359.description: Superlattices of lead chalcogenide colloidal quantum dots hold promise to revolutionise the field of infrared optoelectronics due to their unique combination of optical and transport properties. However, the main challenge remains to form a homogeneous thin-film with long-range order avoiding cracking upon ligand exchange.

pmc-12590657.title: Sun protection behaviors and knowledge of skin cancer and sun exposure among Emirati undergraduate students
pmc-12590657.creator: Huda Anshasi, Hajer Almazrouei, Nojoud Rashed, Reem Salem, Mareyah Suhail, Amal Abdulla
pmc-12590657.description: PurposeThe aim of this study is to assess the level of knowledge about skin cancer and sun exposure among Emirati undergraduate students and evaluate the sun protection behaviors practiced by these students.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted among 455 undergraduate students from 17 campuses of one of the largest higher education institutions in the UAE.

pmc-12694164.title: Plant-Based Polysaccharide Gums as Sustainable Bio-Polymers: Focus on Tragacanth Gum and Its Emerging Applications
pmc-12694164.creator: Shivani Dogra, Dhananjay Yadav, Bhupendra Koul, Muhammad Fazle Rabbee
pmc-12694164.description: Plant-based natural polymers are gaining attention as ecofriendly alternatives to synthetic materials with applications in food, biomedical, pharmaceutical, and environmental science. Tragacanth gum (TG), a natural exudate obtained from Astragalus species, represents a unique polysaccharide with a complex molecular structure and distinctive rheological properties. It has been traditionally used for centuries as a stabilizer and emulsifier.

pmc-12808376.title: Hyperfibrinolysis during intra-aortic balloon pump support: a case report on targeted tranexamic acid therapy
pmc-12808376.creator: Shanshan Dong, Xinshuang Chen, Qi Peng, Jun Yang, Qimei Wei
pmc-12808376.description: Coagulation disturbances in patients with end-stage heart failure receiving intra-aortic balloon pump (IABP) support present significant management challenges. We describe a 49-year-old male with dilated cardiomyopathy awaiting transplantation who developed secondary hyperfibrinolysis following IABP-associated infection and hemodynamic instability. The patient exhibited pronounced D-dimer elevation (peak: 55.84 μg/mL) and persistent oozing at the puncture site.

pmc-13072534.title: Pig productive performance parameters and costs in Spain: evolution from 2015 to 2024
pmc-13072534.creator: Josep Font, Joan Rocadembosch, Josep Bernaus, Olga Miró, Judit Argerich, Laia Cordón, Irene Planas, Just Font, Lorenzo Fraile
pmc-13072534.description: BackgroundThe goals of the present work were to describe reliable reference values and their temporal evolution for production parameters and pig production cost from 2015 to 2024 in Spain. Between 109 and 123 pig production companies from Spain were included in this study from 2015 to 2024.

pmc-13287594.title: Effects of hydrated lime and quarry dust dosage and aging on the relaxation modulus of bituminous mastics
pmc-13287594.creator: K. L. A. V. Harnadh, A. Padmarekha, S. Karuppasamy
pmc-13287594.description: Bituminous mastics are essential in influencing the stiffness and viscoelastic behaviour of asphalt mixtures, as the binder–filler matrix governs stress transfer and deformation resistance in pavements. Understanding the stress relaxation behaviour of mastics is crucial because it indicates the ability of the material to dissipate stresses induced by traffic loading.

pmc-13367551.title: Asthma, COPD, and asthma–COPD overlap: A comparative study of inflammatory biomarkers and quality of life
pmc-13367551.creator: M Ahmed Safwan, Nitin Goel, Raj Kumar

pmc-13396911.title: Distinct intrinsic neural connectivity of an emotion regulation network across the menopausal transition
pmc-13396911.creator: Franziska Weinmar, Ann-Christin S Kimmig, Sofia Amaoui, Laura Gervais, Alkistis Skalkidou, Carmen Morawetz, Birgit Derntl
pmc-13396911.description: Menopause is a major psychoneuroendocrine transition which can impact emotional functioning and mental health. Although emotion regulation (ER) is fundamental for mental health, intrinsic neural connectivity supporting ER across the menopausal transition remains unexplored. Addressing this gap, this study provides the first examination of intrinsic effective connectivity within an ER-related network across menopausal stages.

pmc-13408838.title: Macrophage adenylyl cyclase 7 protects against myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury in male mice
pmc-13408838.creator: Guofang Xia, Simeng Zhu, Yujia Liu, Yifan Shi, Jiaxin Chen, Jingwei Pan, Zhong Chen, Peng Wei, Chengxing Shen, Ailian Du, Congfeng Xu

pmc-13445293.title: pH-shifted walnut protein-bamboo shoot soluble dietary fiber complexes for structuring glucono-δ-lactone-acidified emulsion gels
pmc-13445293.creator: Liu Liu, Hai-Bing Ran, Li-Kang Qin, Yu-Long Jia
pmc-13445293.description: This study developed high-oil (70% v/v) cold-set emulsion gels using pH-shifted walnut protein isolate (PWPI) and bamboo shoot soluble dietary fiber (SDF). pH-shifting significantly improved the solubility of walnut protein from 20.84% to 77.15% and promoted the formation of smaller, more stable protein particles.
